finding: The tightened derivations schema from QA finding B-QA-002 did not land, and G1_CHANGES.md states that it did. derivations[] is complete in count but a second model still cannot re-derive a value from its own row -- which is the only reason the field exists.
evidence: Measured across all 442 derivations: 87% of `expression` values contain more than one distinct number, so they are prose sentences rather than a formula for the one value (e.g. value 6.00 with expression "v=6.00 m/s and delta-x=12.0 m from constant-acceleration relations."). All 1,242 input labels are generic placeholders -- "numeric operand 1" through "numeric operand 6" -- so no operand is named. kind="looked_up" is used 0 times. 11 derivations (2%) carry empty criterion_keys. G1_CHANGES.md claims "each numeric occurrence has a value-specific expression and label/value inputs".
recommended_action: Fix before subject 2, not after subject 8 -- 182 FRQ across seven subjects remain and the cost multiplies. expression must be the formula for that one value; inputs must name the operands meaningfully ("initial velocity", not "numeric operand 1"). Note the looked_up gap is partly the work order's fault: its examples were statistical (t*, z, chi-square) and Physics uses constants such as g=9.80, which appears 22 times. Generalise the wording rather than treating this as a Codex error.
